chapterInfo.content:
5
Ayeforɔ no mpa
1 # Nmd 6.2 Maba me turo mu, me nua, m’ayeforɔ,
meretete me kurobo ne m’aduhwam,
meredi me woɔkyɛm ne me woɔ,
merenom me nsa ne me nufosuo.
Nnamfonom, monnidi,
adɔfonom, monnom na mommee.
2 # Nmd 6.9 Me deɛ, medae, nanso na m’akoma anyane.
Tie! me dɔfoɔ na ɔrebom sɛ:
Hini me, me nuabaa, me dɔfoɔ,
m’aburuburo a wodi mu;
na obosuo ayɛ m’atifi ma,
anadwo nsosɔeɛ ayɛ me mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ ma.
3Mayi m’atadeɛ,
mɛyɛ dɛn mahyɛ?
Mahohoro me nan ho,
mɛyɛ dɛn mayɛ no fi?
4Me dɔfoɔ de ne nsa kaa pono no,
na m’akoma dii ahurisie wɔ me mu.
5Ɛnna mesɔree sɛ merekɔhini me dɔfoɔ no,
kurobo sosɔɔ me nsa ho,
na kurobo a ɛnene sosɔɔ me nsateaa so,
apratwom nsɔmu so.
6 # Nmd 3.1 Mehinii me dɔfoɔ,
nanso na me dɔfoɔ adane ne ho asane kɔ.
Ɔrekasa no, m’akoma tui.
Mehwehwɛɛ no, na manhu no,
mefrɛɛ no, na wannye me so.
7Awɛmfoɔ a wɔkyini kuro mu no
bɛtoo me,
wɔbobɔɔ me, wɔpiraa me,
afasuo so awɛmfoɔ gyee me nkatanimu.
Ayeforɔkunu no ahoɔfɛ
8 # Nmd 2.5 Meka mo ntam, Yerusalem mmammaa,
sɛ mohunu me dɔfoɔ a,
monka nkyerɛ no
sɛ ɔdɔ ayare me.
9Ɛdeɛn na wo dɔfoɔ de sene ɔdɔfoɔ bie,
O mmaa mu ɔhoɔfɛni?
Ɛdeɛn na wo dɔfoɔ de sene ɔdɔfo bie,
sɛ woka ntam gu yɛn so seyie?
10Me dɔfoɔ hoa na ɔbere,
ɔda nso nnipa mpemdu mu.
11Ne tiri yɛ sika amapa pa,
ne mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ yɛ kuhaa,
ɛbiri sɛ anene.
12 # Nmd 4.1 N’aniwa te sɛ
asutene ho mmuruburo
a wɔdware nufosuo,
sisi ne mayɛ soɔ.
13 # Dwom 45.2 N’afono te sɛ aduhwam akofie
a nnuhwam yɛ so yie;
n’anofafa te sɛ sukooko fɛfɛ
a ɛsosɔ kurobo a ɛnene.
14Ne nsa yɛ sika nnwinneɛ
a wɔde sikabereɛboɔ asisi mu,
ne nipadua yɛ asonse adwinneɛ
a wɔde hoaboɔ adura soɔ.
15Ne nan yɛ abofufuo adum
a ɛsisi amapa nnyinasoɔ soɔ,
ne suban te sɛ Lebanon,
wɔayi no sɛ tweneduro nnua.
16N’anomu wɔ adɔkɔdɔkɔwadeɛ,
na ne ho nyinaa yɛ akɔnɔdeɛ ara nko.
Me dɔfoɔ nie, na m’adamfo nie,
O Yerusalem mmammaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
